description: This file provides utility functions for parsing and handling durations, including parsing string representations of durations, calculating the last day of a month, determining time until resets, and calculating the next standardized reset time based on various durations. The functions cover different units like seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, and months, and include timezone handling for aligned reset times.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str] _extract_from_regex(duration: str)
methods.description: Extracts numeric value and unit from duration string using regex.

methods.name: get_last_day_of_month(year, month)
methods.description: Returns the last day of a given month in a specific year.

methods.name: int duration_in_seconds(duration: str)
methods.description: Converts a duration string into total seconds based on the unit.

methods.name: datetime get_next_standardized_reset_time( duration: str, current_time: datetime, timezone_str: str = "UTC" )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time aligned to a standard interval based on the provided duration and current time.

methods.name: Tuple[datetime,timezone] _setup_timezone( current_time: datetime, timezone_str: str = "UTC" )
methods.description: Configures timezone for a given datetime, converting naive datetime to aware in the specified timezone.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[int],Optional[str]] _parse_duration(duration: str)
methods.description: Parses the duration string into numeric value and unit components.

methods.name: datetime _handle_day_reset( current_time: datetime, base_midnight: datetime, value: int, timezone: timezone )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time for day-based durations, including weekly and monthly resets.

methods.name: datetime _handle_hour_reset( current_time: datetime, base_midnight: datetime, value: int )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time aligned to hours.

methods.name: datetime _handle_minute_reset( current_time: datetime, base_midnight: datetime, value: int )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time aligned to minutes.

methods.name: datetime _handle_second_reset( current_time: datetime, base_midnight: datetime, value: int )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time aligned to seconds.

methods.name: datetime _handle_month_reset( current_time: datetime, base_midnight: datetime, value: int )
methods.description: Calculates the next reset time for monthly resets, supporting only 1-month intervals.
